keepTip: The anti tamper function has been activated, and when the door lock is tampered with, an alarm prompt will be issued and an alarm message will be pushed to the APP. The door lock alarm can be disarmed through the 'Plugins Settings Page Alarm' function of the device.
keepCloseTip: Anti skid function is turned off. When the door lock is pried, the alarm tone will not sound. The anti prying function can be enabled through the device plug-in setting page.
powerlockOntip: The electronic anti lock function has been turned on. The external electronic unlocking mode only supports the administrator unlocking mode.
powerlockOfftip: The electronic anti lock function is turned off. The external electronic unlocking mode supports the unlocking mode of all family members.
kidOntip: The child lock function has been turned on. The 'unlock' key function on the rear lock of the door lock is disabled, and only the rear lock emergency knob can be used for indoor unlocking. To close, move the child lock knob on the back panel of the door lock upwards.
kidOfftip: The child lock function is turned off. Press the 'Unlock' button on the back of the door lock gently to unlock the door indoors. To open it, move the child lock knob on the back panel of the door lock downward.
bluConTip: The Bluetooth connection between the mobile phone and the door lock Bluetooth is successful. It supports user management, prompt volume setting, and Bluetooth unlock operations, and real-time access to relevant information about the door lock.
bleDisconTip: The Bluetooth of the mobile phone is not connected to the Bluetooth of the door lock, so the relevant information of the door lock cannot be obtained in real time. Please turn on the Bluetooth function of your phone and close to the door lock. Wait a moment to connect successfully.
